title: RedMagic 12 Pro+ is coming next month, design teased

The company has also revealed some of the design changes coming to the gaming smartphone. According to nubia, the RedMagic 12 Pro+ will offer an excellent in-hand feel. description: Alongside the Find X10 Pro Max, today Oppo has also unveiled the Find X10 and Find X10 E in China. These are more affordable options than the X10 Pro Max, as you may have expected from their names. Let's take them one by one. title: Nothing makes CMF an independent Indian brand
description: Nothing's more affordable CMF sub-brand is now turning into its own independent company, which will be majority Indian-owned, and will have its HQ and R&D in India. Nothing will stay on as a minority shareholder. Nothing's CEO Carl Pei thinks India will be the next country that will produce "its own global champions" in the tech space, following the likes of Japan, Korea, and China. The implication is that CMF will be one of the first such "global champions", since it will have "real R&D" in the country, which he describes as "the ability to design, engineer, and keep improving a product...

title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max launches with three 200MP rear cameras, Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC
description: Oppo has just unveiled its latest flagship smartphone, the Find X10 Pro Max. This is powered by the new MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, just like the vivo X500 Pro Max which was unveiled yesterday. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max one-ups its direct competitor in terms of cameras, though, sporting a whopping three 200MP sensors on the rear. The 24mm main camera uses a 1/1.3-inch type sensor with f/1.5 aperture and two-axis OIS, the 13mm ultrawide uses a 1/1.56-inch sensor, has f/2.2 aperture, autofocus, and an advertised 124-degree field of view, while the 70mm telephoto camera uses another...

title: Here's when the vivo X500 series is launching in Europe
description: vivo launched the X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max in China yesterday, and today the company has already revealed when they're coming to Europe. The European launch event will take place on October 27, which is also when pre-orders will start. The devices will then be released on November 5. There is, however, something you need to know - while vivo's page talks about the "X500 series", the vanilla X500 is not shown. title: OnePlus N6 Lite goes official with a 7,000mAh battery
description: OnePlus has expanded its N6 lineup in India with the launch of the new OnePlus N6 Lite. The affordable 4G smartphone packs a 7,000mAh battery and joins the OnePlus N6 and N6x in the country. The OnePlus N6 Lite is priced at INR 16,999 for the sole 4GB RAM and 64GB storage variant. It is available in Midnight Black and a bright Neo Green colorway. It is powered by the Unisoc T7250 chipset and comes with a 6.75-inch LCD display that offers a 120Hz refresh rate and 900 nits in high-brightness mode. description: The Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max are set to launch tomorrow in China, and the company has now revealed more details about their rear camera systems. description: Oppo launched the A7 Pro Max in China in August, and now the phone has finally made its way to other markets, including Austria in Europe.
